title: LEARNING TO LIE: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING ATTACKS DAMAGE HUMAN-AI TEAMS AND TEAMS OF LLMS
reasoning: The paper investigates adversarial reinforcement learning attacks in human-AI teams, specifically focused on an AI agent's ability to 'lie' to damage team performance. It evaluates team dynamics, trust evolution, and cognitive biases (like automation bias and recency bias), and benchmarks several LLMs on an influence allocation task. It does not evaluate religion, social bias, or ethical/moral reasoning frameworks beyond standard procedural ethics.
